channel.description: Recent content in CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template Changelog on CoreUI

item.title: CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.7.20 - Search Button and Angular 22.1.3 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.7.20. This update adds a search button view with a trigger in the default header, aligns the template with Angular 22.1.3, and refreshes the bundled CoreUI packages.

item.title: CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.7.18 - Redesigned Authentication Views and Refreshed Dashboard
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.7.18. This update redesigns the authentication views to match the new CoreUI layout, syncs the dashboard with the refreshed CoreUI content, reorganizes the navigation and views, and aligns the template with Angular 22.1.2.

item.title: CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.7.16 - Angular 22.1.1 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.7.16. This maintenance update aligns the template with Angular 22.1.1 and refreshes the bundled CoreUI packages.

item.title: CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.7.15 - Alert Fix and Dependency Refresh
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.7.15. This maintenance update corrects the dismissible condition in alerts, refreshes the bundled CoreUI packages, and keeps the template current with Angular 22.1 tooling.

item.title: CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.7.11 - Angular 22.1 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.7.11. This update aligns the template with Angular 22.1.0, refreshes the bundled CoreUI packages, and keeps Angular dashboard projects current with the latest maintenance improvements.

item.title: CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.7.9 - CoreUI Package Refresh
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.7.9. This maintenance update refreshes the bundled CoreUI packages, moves the CoreUI Bootstrap package to 5.9.0, and patches a security advisory in a transitive dependency.

item.title: CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.7.6 - Angular 22.0.7 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.7.6. This update aligns the template with Angular 22.0.7, refreshes the bundled CoreUI packages, and keeps Angular dashboard projects current with the latest maintenance improvements.

item.title: CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.7.4 - Angular 22 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.7.4. This update aligns the template with Angular 22.0.6, refreshes the bundled CoreUI packages, and keeps Angular dashboard projects current with the latest maintenance improvements.

item.title: CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.6.24 - Angular 21.2.14 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.6.24. This update aligns the template with Angular 21.2.14, refreshes the bundled CoreUI packages, and keeps Angular dashboard projects current with the latest maintenance improvements.

item.title: CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.6.23 - Angular 21.2.12 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.6.23. This update aligns the template with Angular 21.2.12, refreshes the bundled CoreUI packages, and keeps Angular dashboard projects current with the latest maintenance improvements.

item.title: CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.6.22 - Angular 21.2.10 Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.6.22. This security and maintenance update brings full support for Angular 21.2.10, includes updated CoreUI for Angular v5.6.22 components, and addresses multiple security vulnerabilities. This release ensures your Angular admin dashboard runs securely with the latest framework improvements.

item.title: CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.6.21 - Security Update
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.6.21. This critical security update brings full support for Angular 21.2.5, includes updated CoreUI for Angular v5.6.21 components, and addresses multiple security vulnerabilities in the undici package. This release ensures your Angular admin dashboard runs securely with the latest framework improvements.

item.title: CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.6.18
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.6.18. This maintenance update brings Angular 21.2.1 support, critical security patches, and updated CoreUI for Angular components.

item.title: CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.6.17
item.description: We are pleased to announce the release of CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.6.17. This update brings full support for Angular 21.2, resolves Chart.js animation issues, and includes the latest CoreUI for Angular components to keep your admin dashboard modern, secure, and performant.

item.title: CoreUI Free Angular 21 Admin Template v5.6.0
item.description: The CoreUI Free Angular 21 Admin Template v5.6.0 is now available as of December 9th, 2025. This update includes an upgrade to Angular 21, ensuring that your applications run smoothly and efficiently with the latest technology stack.

item.title: CoreUI Free Angular 20 Admin Template v5.5.3
item.description: The CoreUI Free Angular 20 Admin Template v5.5.3 is now available as of July 2nd, 2025. This update includes an upgrade to Angular 20, ensuring that your applications run smoothly and efficiently with the latest technology stack.

item.title: CoreUI Free Angular 18.2 Admin Template v5.2.16
item.description: The CoreUI Free Angular 18.2 Admin Template v5.2.16 is now available as of August 27, 2024. This update includes an upgrade to Angular 18.2, ensuring that your applications run smoothly and efficiently with the latest technology stack.

item.title: CoreUI Free Angular 18.1 Admin Template v5.2.5
item.description: We are happy to announce that the CoreUI Free Angular 18.1 Admin Template v5.2.5 is now available as of July 12, 2024. This update involves a migration to Angular 18.1. Upgrading to this version will guarantee that your applications operate smoothly and efficiently with the latest technology stack.

item.title: CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.0.0
item.description: We’re pleased to announce the CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template v5.0.0 release on March 28, 2024. This significant update introduces a series of fixes and refinements to enhance the template’s functionality, usability, and overall performance. Central to this release is the transition to CoreUI v5, reflecting our commitment to staying aligned with the latest in web development practices and technologies.
